sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles list). Guides are written in our own words from the cited sources; a source is cited, never copied.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task. Finish the story, the 100% completion checklist, the side questlines and the miscellaneous trophies, and the platinum is yours. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10, with no online trophies and no difficulty settings to worry about.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks on its own as the story starts; you cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter ends — right after you complete the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It pops after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Automatic story trophy — play through and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It pops after the final mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero. Automatic story trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the game, Starting From Zero at the end of Chapter 4. The story ends, free-roam opens for the cleanup, and the gold pops.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. Story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. Story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. Story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy — it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy and the bulk of the platinum run. After the story, the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and anything you did during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds (closer to 60% true completion): you need any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), all underwater discoveries, all shooting-range golds, all drone races, Bret's quests, 15 of 18 card sets and 15 of 18 meditations. Nothing on the list is missable — everything can be finished in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (the 100% checklist asks for 300). There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them however you like; flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where every stunt has its own name and stays marked once done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them in Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find them. Most unlock naturally while you play, so this usually pops on its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the 12 shooting ranges. The golds are not too hard — take your time, learn each range's layout and scoring, and work through them one at a time. All 42 golds are also required for the 100% completion checklist.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). You need a win at each location, not a win in every race — so pick the easiest race at each spot. All 14 locations are also required for the 100% completion checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, and any mix counts — car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races. Each win at a new location adds to the count, so keep racing new spots rather than repeating the same one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (use the controllers), and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of any one game once — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: after a call from Andy she texts you her home address in Belville. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline is marked in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked with a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure: find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back — 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3; playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up. Track progress in Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain strangers count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more still being found. Every strand stays available in free-roam after the story. Check your count in the trophy tracker.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His 'Randy's Wish List' questline is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 high-end sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green 'RK' icon); he marks some on the map, and you can steal the rest off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to check if it is on the list, and deliver it in good condition for more pay. Track the list in Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This to shut the labs down. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots at 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice, and you can track them in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. WARNING — the only potentially missable trophy in the game: one meditation happens only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. That meditation raises the counter but is not marked as a spot, so it is still unclear whether it is required; do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The last meditation needs both characters together, which unlocks after Chapter 2, Coffee Break.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret Vogel marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Lucia cannot get the message; Jason only). Do the quest, then he marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Track the hunts in Map > Activities > Target Deck (15 decks; all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets across Leonida, and you need any 3 full sets for this trophy (15 sets for the 100% checklist). Cards are scattered through the world — check the map's collectible markers and your collection progress in Progress > Collections.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Aim the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) at scannable objects in the world — landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. There are more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges and you only need 50 here (70 for the 100% checklist), so skip the hardest 10. Track them in Progress > Challenges; most complete naturally while you work on other trophies, then pick the quickest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. First possible after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape the red heat zone: a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is an easy escape route (cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you). It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner (Right + Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying chased — keep the flashing red/blue wanted level, not the solid red heat level. Wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (available after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a couple of items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs, and if the trophy does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly) and scan vehicles — stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by; you only need to scan them, not drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this pops on the way. Check progress in Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline (L1, then Triangle) to stretch the window, wear body armor, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 for full-auto accuracy. Line up 5 enemies — gang-operation criminals work; it does not seem to count soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier later and will likely pop naturally by Focus level 4.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal (connected to a boarding bridge — the planes parked on the airfield do not count). The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons). Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (kick the door and the alarm goes off, so don't), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag (hold Right to hand one off). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (purple icons) — you must have done his earlier quests (2 Payday Loan robberies) first. Vault robberies instantly give 4 stars, so escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles to go unrecognized. There are 8 large bank jobs; you need 5 here, all 8 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing the armored truck that delivered the cash. For an earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests), then escape the red heat radius. You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist, so it pops on the way regardless.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Fully unfog the whole map — the fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations; you need one operation per gang for this trophy (all 39 for the 100% checklist). Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track each gang's count in Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City — only that car counts; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs), then hack into the Banshee, drive forward straight through the showroom window, and keep driving — the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling (marked automatically), steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can return for whatever you missed; it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can only do this after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a gym membership and always train together — call your partner (Right + Triangle) and while one character works out, the other trains automatically, doubling progress. Filter fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives and clean escapes push you Professional; incapacitating without killing is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass cop and civilian kills are Psycho; keep going and you hit Irredeemable (permanent — cops shoot on sight more often). It happens passively while you do robberies and the 100% checklist; if it is the last one left, running over civilians and cops with a car farms it fast.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. During the Prologue, Lucia robs a Payday Loans store — later in the game, return to the same store as Lucia, rob it again and get away on foot (not in a vehicle). You are recreating the prologue robbery.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM, and come alone. The UFO encounter is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn — if nothing happens, leave and try another night.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — it is believed to be kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Try knocking enemies down with melee attacks from a moving bike. Treat this one as unconfirmed until players verify the method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3, Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery (unlocked after Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is…), so it comes naturally with the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — they are the most expensive. Any shop counts: 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (total $160,000; the 4 story garages don't count). Garages unlock for purchase after Chapter 2, Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app was installed on your phone. Buy them through the app. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after Chapter 2, Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen cars and have them delivered anywhere. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then in his garage choose Respray and Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
